editor_reconstruction_note: Light-grey rounded box appears upper-centre (f10) then text types on letter by letter: 'Q. If the Hubble telescope were aimed at the Earth, how detailed would the images be?' in black serif; figure and rectangle unchanged.
Attribution line types on under the question: first '—Kyle', then replaced/extended to '—Kyle Rankin' (small bold).
Black-ink line drawing of the Hubble telescope (tilted, solar panels, aperture right) appears at once inside the rectangle.

Partial Earth limb arc with dashed atmosphere lines and coastline appears at right edge of the rectangle (single activity frame). Whether it continues growing is UNRESOLVED (see G0009 where arc is larger).

Hard cut at 6.375s to full-frame red textured title card: black T-rex silhouette chewing a Hubble drawing upper-centre; white 'xkcd's' / 'what if?' / 'THE VIDEO SERIES'. T-rex head/jaw pose differs subtly between sampled frames. Last activity frame (8.375s) is a hard cut to the next white scene (figure with globe). Exact timing of T-rex pose changes UNRESOLVED.
Right half gains a row of NASA-logo desks with monitors and a seated ponytailed stick figure working at a laptop (one frame; second desk partly cut at right edge).
Seated figure replaced by standing figure holding a laptop aloft showing 'FAQs' with web-page header (tiny text unreadable at tile scale); chair stays.
Hard cut to near-black frame with large blurred-glow white sphere centre-left and smaller glowing white sphere upper-right (overexposed Earth and Moon).
Red zigzag scribble drawn progressively over the large white sphere, upper-left to lower-right.

Glow dissolves into greyscale detailed Earth and Moon on starfield while the red scribble fades; Earth and Moon drift rightward across the frame; a bearded stick figure with glasses holding a book/tablet slides in from the left edge.

Hubble line drawing in white ink plus label 'WIDE FIELD PLANETARY CAMERA 2 (WFPC2)' appear between figure and Earth (onset f436); scene (Earth, figure, Moon) appears shifted upward vs previous hold. No further visible change across the remaining frames at tile scale: UNRESOLVED whether a slow drift or fade continues.
Hand-lettered 'TOO SLOW' types on at top centre; then a curved arrow is drawn from the text down to the Hubble.
Hard cut to flat top-down illustration: brown/tan desk on light-grey floor with tablet, hammer and dice on it, blue swivel chair below.
Hard cut to white canvas with a thin grey ground band and black ground line along the bottom edge.
Two lighter grey atmosphere bands stack up above the ground band; then hand-lettered labels 'SPACE' (upper) and 'ATMOSPHERE' (in band) appear.

Small ground telescope icon with label 'EARTH-BASED TELESCOPE' (partly cut off at bottom edge) appears; then red lines are drawn upward from it, bending slightly in the atmosphere and fanning out into space.
Small telescope icon with label 'SPACE-BASED TELESCOPE' appears upper right; red rays are drawn downward from it, fanning to the ground below the atmosphere band.
Hard cut to live-action overhead photograph, blurred, of a tablet showing 'INTERNET GONE'-style screen, a hammer, and red and blue toy bricks on a pale wooden table.
Photo goes from blurred to sharp while the framing shifts (objects move and enlarge); a real human hand enters from left carrying a transparent plastic bag and lays it over the tablet.
Hard cut to blank white canvas; heading '1) RESOLUTION' types on at top centre.
Hubble drawing with label 'HUBBLE' pops on at left-centre.

Black horizontal line drawn left-to-right becomes an arrow; label 'DISTANCE TO OBJECT' appears under it; then four framed panels pop on one after another left to right, each a Death-Star-like sphere shown as a large image over a smaller image, getting progressively smaller/blurrier/pixelated.
Panels 1-3, arrow and its label fade out; scatter of black dots appears on the right; the fourth panel becomes a small circle labelled 'PLUTO'. Hubble remains.
Small probe icon with label 'NEW HORIZONS' appears below Pluto (single frame).
A dark rounded speech-bubble with a real colour photo of Pluto grows from the New Horizons probe, scaling up from small to large over about 9 frames.
A second bubble grows from Hubble showing a blurry grey pixelated blob (Hubble's Pluto), scaling up beside the sharp Pluto bubble.
Hard cut to white canvas: Hubble small at top centre, desk with chair at bottom edge.
Label '535 km' types in at mid-height; then a vertical double-headed arrow is drawn between Hubble and the desk.
Hard cut to blurred top-down desk illustration (desk, tablet, hammer, chair) on grey, desk smaller than in G0027.
Blue-grey shingle roof texture with a white brown-framed skylight around the desk sweeps in from the left over the grey; small grey object at right of roof. Desk stays put.
Roof layer with skylight slides out to the right revealing blurred green lawn with darker green bushes; desk stays centre.
Hard cut to blank white canvas; heading '2) MOTION' types on at top centre.

Over ~8.7s: Hubble top centre and desk on a ground line appear; red arrow labelled '7 km/s' (pointing right) appears; Hubble then leaves and re-enters from the right with motion blur; desk blurs and slides across the ground line; arrow flips to point left; label '*CLICK' appears beside Hubble. Exact choreography between sampled frames UNRESOLVED.
Hard cut to full-frame photographic horizontal motion-blur streaks in grey/white with a darker vertical band; texture shifts across frames (blur sweep).
Hard cut to white canvas with two small framed images joined by '+': blurred desk labelled 'PROBLEM: RESOLUTION' and motion-streaked grey square labelled 'PROBLEM: MOTION'.
'=' sign and a third framed grey-blur image labelled 'BIGGER PROBLEM: RESOLUTION + MOTION' appear.
Deadpan stick figure appears right with speech 'WAS THIS TAKEN OUT OF A MOVING CAR?'; red scribble is then drawn progressively over the third panel.

Hard-to-sample ~6s sequence on white: Hubble upper-left with a red sight line to ground and desk (blurred, sliding) at the bottom; red line fans into several fading lines; later desk gone, Hubble ghosted upper-left with horizontal grey line and a second solid Hubble lower-left with a grey wedge and slanted grey line. Intermediate steps UNRESOLVED.
Whole canvas slides left (Hubble figures exit left edge) with motion blur; a spiral-galaxy image enters from the right, blurry then resolving into a dotted/pixel galaxy; grey lines stay.
Canvas slides back right: galaxy blurs and exits right; Moon with arrow and label 'MOON' enters upper left and Hubble returns lower-left (blurred then sharp).
Slanted line turns from grey to red, wedge fills red and Hubble rotates steeper upward so the line climbs to the upper right.
Black dashed vertical line drawn downward at right; label 'AUTOMATIC ON-BOARD TRACKING ALGORITHM LIMIT' types on line by line to its left.
'(TOO CLOSE)' fades in beneath 'MOON'.

Diagram slides right with heavy motion blur; a new left panel enters showing a NASA-logo desk with seated operator, wall monitor and a standing stick figure, with header 'MANUAL TRACKING'; vertical divider; old diagram occupies right half.
Over ~2.2s Hubble in the right panel rotates upward, red wedge widens and line swings to point at the Moon circle; 'MOON' label greys out. Operator panel unchanged.
Operator redrawn from upright to leaning forward over keyboard, with ghosted intermediate pose.

Black panel with a grey photographic lunar mosaic wipes in from the left covering the manual-tracking panel then the right panel; a colour full-Moon photo with beam lines lower right; tiny captions at bottom including 'Crater Copernicus on Earth's Moon' and 'Moon' (rest unreadable at tile scale).
Hard cut to full-frame photo of a red/blue nebula with bright white centre on starfield; small caption bottom-left 'AG Carinae' (rest unreadable).
White 'MANUAL TRACKING' panel (standing figure, leaning operator) wipes in from the left over the nebula, then the right region turns to a blurred top-down desk image on grey.
Hard cut to two-panel split: left Hubble top with red vertical line to a ghosted Moon below; right Hubble with grey vertical line to a desk with chair; black divider centre.
Right Hubble tilts and its line becomes red and slanted toward a motion-blurred desk sliding left; grey vertical reference line stays.
Left panel and divider slide out left (ghosting) so the right panel fills the frame.
Curved red arrow (angle indicator) appears between the red line and the grey vertical line.
Red label '~1°/second' appears beneath the angle arrow.

Diagram slides left to half-width; heading 'EXPECTATION' appears over it; new right panel headed 'REALITY' slides in from the right with Hubble, a near-vertical red line and a small red arrow; divider line.
Single frame, low pixel change; no difference visible at tile scale. UNRESOLVED.
Red label '6°/minute' appears in the REALITY panel beside the red line.
Dashed shake/vibration marks appear around the REALITY Hubble.
Hard cut to white canvas with one large Hubble drawing centred, no labels.
Hubble appears larger and shifted up-left in one frame, with new detail at the left: chain/gear mechanism and a tiny bicycle-riding figure. Whether it animates between frames UNRESOLVED.
Label '77,217 kg·m²' with curved arrow pointing at the Hubble body appears upper centre.
Curved arrow and a framed carousel drawing appear right of the label.
Small stick figure with raised arms appears upper left beside the bicycle.
Earth limb with dashed atmosphere rings and coastline appears lower right.
Label and carousel fade out; a grey speech-bubble with a pixelated top-down desk image and blue swivel chair grows from the Hubble body (tiny icon first, then full bubble upper right).
Camera zooms into the speech bubble with motion blur until the blurred desk image fills the frame.

Blue chair (with visible legs/feet) rolls and spins across the grey floor from the desk toward lower left; at the end the view zooms back out to the bubble on white at upper right. Zoom-out timing UNRESOLVED.
Large black silhouette satellite with diagonal bar 'REDACTED' appears left of the bubble; bubble gets a tail pointing to it.
Earth arc with dashed rings appears lower right.
Small American flag appears on the upper-left panel of the black satellite.

Hard cut to red textured end card: T-rex/Hubble art left; 'GET THE BOOKS: xkcd.com/books' with four book covers; small credits at right (names including Randall Munroe, Henry Reich, Lizah van der Aart, Ever Salazar, Know Art Studios; role text mostly unreadable).
